name: Dotted line logo flow
what: A long dotted line snakes across a dark board in four rows. Logos drop in from above as pixel mosaics, then the line lights up dash by dash from the top left and each logo it reaches resolves from mosaic into the sharp logo, until the line ends at a padlock that opens. Put a logo from the library or your own picture in each of the six spots.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f2-f34 six logos drop in from above the frame as pixel mosaics, staggered, each on a quick-start, long-soft-landing curve; from f26 the dotted line lights up dash by dash in the flow colour, leg by leg from the top left (f26-28, f67-98, f155-173, f197-209, f231-242, f267-277, f314-323); as it reaches each logo the mosaic resolves into the sharp logo over ~10 f (f31-41, f98-123, f173-183, f209-219, f242-251, f279-290); at f326-f338 the padlock at the end opens (the shackle lifts, the body turns to an outline)

tracks.name: logos drop in
tracks.what: six logo mosaics drop in from above the frame, one after another
tracks.easing: cubic-bezier(0.22, 0, 0.04, 0.88) (measured fit, quick start, long soft landing)

tracks.name: line lights up
tracks.what: the dashes turn to the flow colour one by one along the line, leg by leg
tracks.easing: dash by dash (measured frame of each dash)

tracks.name: mosaics resolve
tracks.what: each logo's mosaic gets finer in 10 steps and snaps sharp as the line reaches it (the second logo lingers on a fine mosaic first)

tracks.name: padlock opens
tracks.what: the shackle lifts and the solid body turns to an outline
